description_good_justification: The README opens with what the site is: the personal site and blog of Alexander Vassbotn Røyne-Helgesen, built by a small set of Node scripts and deployed to GitHub Pages: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md
interact_justification: The README explains how to build the site, and the contributing guide how to ask questions, report bugs (GitHub issues) and contribute: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_justification: The contribution process (issues, pull requests, checks, sign-off): https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contributing-code
contribution_requirements_justification: Contribution requirements, including coding style and the checks a change must pass: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-style
floss_license_justification: The code is MIT-licensed: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/LICENSE. The posts and the author's own assets are content, not software, and are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/LICENSE-CONTENT
floss_license_osi_justification: The code is under the MIT licence, which is OSI-approved.
documentation_basics_justification: The README describes the requirements and how to build the site, and the contributing guide how to check it and write a post: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md#development and https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contributing-code
documentation_interface_justification: The external interface is the set of npm scripts that build and check the site, each described in the contributing guide, and the front matter of a post: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#checks
sites_https_justification: The repository is on GitHub over HTTPS, and the site is served by GitHub Pages with HTTPS enforced: https://phun-ky.net
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are searchable, addressable by URL and open to anyone with a GitHub account: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/issues
english_justification: All documentation is in English, and reports and comments in English are accepted.
maintained_justification: The site is actively maintained, with changes merged and deployed in October 2026: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
repo_track_justification: Git tracks every change, its author and when it was made: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/commits/main
repo_interim_justification: Work in progress is on public branches and pull requests before it is merged: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/pulls
version_unique_justification: The site has no releases: every merge to main is deployed, and each deploy is identified by its unique git commit, shown on the deploy run in GitHub Actions: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
version_semver_justification: The site is deployed continuously from main and has no version numbers; a website has no users who pick a version to install.
version_tags_justification: There are no releases to tag; each deploy is identified by its commit on main.
release_notes_justification: The site has no releases: every change is a pull request with a description of what it changes, deployed when it is merged. The merged pull requests are the record of changes: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
release_notes_vulns_justification: There are no releases, and no publicly known vulnerability has been fixed. A fix would be described in a GitHub security advisory, as the security policy says: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported as GitHub issues with a bug report template: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-bugs
report_responses_justification: Every bug report in the last year has been acknowledged and labelled by the maintainer; the issues are public: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/issues?q=is%3Aissue
enhancement_responses_justification: Every enhancement request in the last year has been answered, and decisions are recorded in the issue: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/issues?q=is%3Aissue
report_archive_justification: All issues and pull requests stay public and searchable on GitHub: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The security policy describes how to report a vulnerability and how reports are handled: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Reports can be sent privately with GitHub private vulnerability reporting or by email to security@phun-ky.net: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability has been reported in the last 6 months. The policy is to acknowledge a report within 7 days: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
build_justification: npm run build builds the site into dist/: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md#development
build_common_tools_justification: The build uses Node.js and npm scripts.
build_floss_tools_justification: The site is built with Node.js, npm and open source npm packages only.
test_justification: The site is checked as it is built, with checks that are open source and in the repository: links, metadata, the Content Security Policy, accessibility with axe on every page in Chrome, layout at three widths and performance budgets: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#checks
test_invocation_justification: Each check is an npm script (npm run check:*), listed in the contributing guide: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#checks
test_most_justification: The checks cover the whole build: every page is loaded in Chrome and checked for requests to other hosts, Content Security Policy violations, horizontal scrolling and accessibility, and every internal link, page title, description and policy is checked.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions runs every check on every pull request and push to main; the check job is required before merging: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
test_policy_justification: New functionality must come with a check that covers it, and a fix with a check that fails without it where one can be written: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#checks
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes came with checks: the fix for indented code in old posts added check:posts, the accessibility fixes added axe on every page, and the metadata work added check:metadata: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
tests_documented_added_justification: The contributing guide says which checks a change must come with: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#checks
warnings_justification: ESLint (eslint-config-phun-ky) lints the JavaScript and the Markdown, and Prettier checks formatting.
warnings_fixed_justification: The code has no ESLint warnings or errors; the lint step fails on any.
warnings_strict_justification: npm run lint fails on any ESLint warning (--max-warnings 0), and lint and formatting errors fail the required check job.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer knows how to design secure software. The principles applied: no server and nothing stored, nothing loaded from other hosts, a strict Content Security Policy with hashes for inline code, least-privilege CI tokens, pinned Actions and deploys only after the checks pass: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
know_common_errors_justification: The maintainer knows the common errors for this kind of software: cross-site scripting (a hash-based Content Security Policy on every page, checked in a browser), third-party content and tracking (nothing from other hosts, checked in CI), and supply chain (locked and reviewed dependencies, pinned Actions, dependency review): https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_published_justification: The site implements and calls no cryptography: it is static HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no accounts, forms or server. HTTPS is provided by GitHub Pages. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations

delivery_mitm_justification: The site is delivered by GitHub Pages with HTTPS enforced, and the repository by GitHub over HTTPS.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hashes are fetched over HTTP; npm verifies package integrity from the lockfile and registry over HTTPS.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No vulnerability of medium or higher severity reaches the site. One medium advisory, in minimatch (published on 30 October 2026), and one low, in katex, are in development tools only, with no fixed version their parents allow yet; both are recorded as not affecting the site: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/vex.openvex.json
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerability has been found in the site or its dependencies.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The project uses no credentials, and GitHub secret scanning with push protection is enabled: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (GitHub default setup) analyses the JavaScript and the workflows on every pull request, push to main and weekly, and ESLint runs on every pull request: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#code-scanning
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL looks for common vulnerabilities in JavaScript, such as cross-site scripting and incomplete sanitisation.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL findings are fixed before merging; an error or a high or critical alert blocks the merge. For example, its incomplete sanitisation alerts in the description and figure code were fixed: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#code-scanning
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every pull request and push to main.
dynamic_analysis_justification: check:browser loads every page in Chrome on every pull request and fails on Content Security Policy violations, requests to other hosts, horizontal scrolling and axe accessibility violations: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/scripts/checks/browser.mjs
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: All the code is JavaScript, which is memory-safe; there is no C, C++ or other memory-unsafe code.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The site's scripts run without extra assertions in the browser checks; the checks themselves fail on what they find.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Problems found by the browser checks are fixed before merging, such as the accessibility violations axe found when it was added: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/pull/186
achieve_passing_justification: The project has the passing badge: https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/15904
dco_justification: Every commit must be signed off under the Developer Certificate of Origin, checked on every pull request by the DCO app and required by the ruleset on main: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin
governance_justification: The maintainer-led governance model and how decisions are made: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
roles_responsibilities_justification: The maintainer and contributor roles and their responsibilities, and who holds them: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles
access_continuity_justification: One maintainer holds the access to the repository and the phun-ky.net domain today. Deploys use no personal token, the code is MIT and the posts CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, but no second person holds access yet: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity
bus_factor_justification: The project has one maintainer, so the bus factor is 1: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/graphs/contributors
documentation_roadmap_justification: What the project plans, considers and will not do from October 2026 to October 2027, linking the issues: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
documentation_architecture_justification: The posts, the page templates and components, the build scripts, the metadata and Content Security Policy steps, and the checks: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#architecture
documentation_security_justification: What visitors can and cannot rely on: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
documentation_quick_start_justification: Readers open https://phun-ky.net with nothing to install. To build the site: npm ci and npm run build, then serve dist/: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md#development
documentation_current_justification: The README, contributing guide, security policy, governance and roadmap were brought up to date with the October 2026 overhaul and with the pull request for these answers. CI lints the Markdown with ESLint and checks that every file and heading linked from .bestpractices.json and security-insights.yml exists.
documentation_achievements_justification: The README shows the OpenSSF Best Practices and Scorecard badges: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: check:browser loads every page in Chrome on every pull request and runs axe (WCAG 2.2 A and AA) in both themes, and fails on sideways scrolling; the coding style requires everything to work with the keyboard and a screen reader, in both themes and from 320 px wide: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/scripts/checks/browser.mjs
internationalization_justification: The site and its posts are in English only. The text is in the templates and the posts, not in message files, so translating it would mean changing them.
sites_password_security_justification: The project sites (GitHub and a static site on GitHub Pages) store no passwords for external users; the site has no accounts or sign in.
maintenance_or_update_justification: There is one version, the live site: every visitor gets the current one, so there is no older version to maintain or upgrade from: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerabilities have been reported to the project in the last 12 months; the repository has no security advisories: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/security/advisories
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: Reports are made privately through GitHub private vulnerability reporting or by email. Acknowledgement within 7 days, assessment, a fix against a draft GitHub security advisory, disclosure once deployed, and credit: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
coding_standards_justification: Code follows the project ESLint configuration (eslint-config-phun-ky), which also lints the Markdown, and Prettier, with rules specific to the site, and must pass npm run lint and npm run format:check: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-style
coding_standards_enforced_justification: The check job runs ESLint with no warnings allowed and Prettier on every pull request, and the ruleset on main requires it to pass before merging.
build_standard_variables_justification: No native binaries are built; Node scripts generate the HTML pages.
build_preserve_debug_justification: The site's own scripts and styles are served as written, not minified or compiled, so nothing is lost for debugging; Prism is served as its authors publish it on npm.
build_non_recursive_justification: npm run build runs the build scripts once, one after another; nothing builds recursively.
build_repeatable_justification: Dependencies are locked in package-lock.json and installed with npm ci. Building the same commit twice gives identical output (1 188 files), and after each deploy check:live checks that the live pages match the build byte for byte: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/scripts/checks/live.mjs
installation_common_justification: The site is a website: nothing is installed or uninstalled. Visitors open it in a browser.
installation_standard_variables_justific: The site is a website: nothing is installed, so there are no installation locations to honour.
installation_development_quick_justifica: git clone, npm ci and npm run build give the full development environment, and npm test and the npm run check:* scripts run the checks: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md#development
external_dependencies_justification: Prism, the only package served to visitors, and the development dependencies are listed in package.json and locked in package-lock.json: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot checks npm dependencies and GitHub Actions weekly and opens security updates at once, and dependency review checks every pull request: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
updateable_reused_components_justificati: Dependencies come from npm through package.json and the lockfile, and Dependabot opens update pull requests. Prism is copied from node_modules at build time, not committed, and no third-party code is copied into the repository.
interfaces_current_justification: The code uses current interfaces: ES modules, Node 24 in CI, Markdoc, and current GitHub Actions pinned to commit SHAs.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: The check job runs the unit tests, lints, builds the site and runs every check on the build (links, metadata, the Content Security Policy, every page in Chrome, performance budgets) on every pull request and before every deploy: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
regression_tests_added50_justification: 19 of the 22 fix commits since May 2026 were merged in a pull request that added or changed a test or check, such as check:metadata, check:posts and the browser check for requests to other hosts.
test_statement_coverage80_justification: Statement coverage is not measured for the build scripts (about 3 900 lines). They run in full on every pull request, building every page, and the build is checked page by page, but the unit tests cover only the post summaries and the commit-msg hook.
test_policy_mandated_justification: New functionality must come with a check that covers it, and a bug fix with a check that fails without it where one can be written: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#checks
implement_secure_design_justification: Secure design principles applied (economy of mechanism, fail-safe defaults, least privilege, complete mediation, open design, no dynamic code, minimal dependencies): https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md#secure-design-principles
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: The site implements and calls no cryptography: it is static HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no accounts, forms or server, and it makes no network requests beyond loading its own files. HTTPS and its certificates are GitHub Pages' and the browser's. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations

crypto_used_network_justification: The site loads only its own files, which GitHub Pages serves only over HTTPS, and the Content Security Policy allows no other origin. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations

signed_releases_justification: There are no releases: the site is continuously delivered from main to GitHub Pages, and nothing is distributed for anyone to download or install: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md#deploying
version_tags_signed_justification: There are no releases and no tags: each deployed version is a commit on main. Commits are not signed.
input_validation_justification: The pages read no input but the visitor's theme choice, only ever compared with light. The build reads only the repository, and the talk list fetched from Sessionize is refused if it has anything that loads or runs code: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md#trust-boundaries
hardening_justification: A Content Security Policy on every page that starts from default-src 'none', allows scripts only from the site and inline code only by hash, no plugins or form submissions; nothing from other hosts, no dynamic code, read-only CI permissions with SHA-pinned actions, and CodeQL on every pull request: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
assurance_case_justification: What is protected, the threat model, trust boundaries, secure design principles, the common weaknesses countered and the known gaps: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md
osps_ac_01_01_justification: The maintainer, the only person with access, uses two-factor authentication on GitHub, which GitHub requires for code contributors. Anyone given access later must use it too: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#becoming-a-maintainer
osps_ac_02_01_justification: GitHub requires a role to be chosen for every collaborator invited to the repository, and the governance requires the lowest role that fits: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#becoming-a-maintainer
osps_ac_03_01_justification: The ruleset on main requires changes to arrive through a pull request with passing checks; only the maintainer, as administrator, can bypass it.
osps_ac_03_02_justification: A separate ruleset on main, with no bypass, blocks deleting the branch and force pushes.
osps_br_01_01_justification: No workflow interpolates untrusted metadata, such as pull request titles or branch names, into a script; the commit message check gets the pull request's commit SHAs through environment variables: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
osps_br_01_03_justification: Pull requests run on the pull_request event, where forks get no secrets. The labeler runs on pull_request_target but never checks out or runs pull request code. The site deploys only from main, after a merge.
osps_br_03_01_justification: All official channels use HTTPS: the GitHub repository and the site at https://phun-ky.net, where GitHub Pages enforces HTTPS.
osps_br_03_02_justification: The site, the only thing distributed, is served only over HTTPS by GitHub Pages, and HTTP redirects to it: https://phun-ky.net
osps_br_07_01_justification: GitHub secret scanning with push protection is enabled and blocks commits that contain secrets; the project has no secrets: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets
osps_do_01_01_justification: Readers open the site; how to build it: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md#development, and how to write a post: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#writing-a-post
osps_do_02_01_justification: How to report a bug, with an issue template: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-bugs
osps_gv_02_01_justification: Proposed changes and usage problems are discussed in public GitHub issues and pull requests: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/issues
osps_le_02_01_justification: The source code is under the MIT licence, which is OSI-approved: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/LICENSE
osps_le_02_02_justification: The code the site serves, its own and Prism, is under the MIT licence, which is OSI-approved. The posts and the author's own images are content, not software, under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; images by others keep their own licence, credited where they are used: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/LICENSE-CONTENT
osps_le_03_01_justification: The licence is in the LICENSE file at the repository root: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/LICENSE
osps_le_03_02_justification: Each deployed version is a commit on main, whose source includes the LICENSE and LICENSE-CONTENT files; Prism's licence is deployed next to it, in js/prism/LICENSE: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/scripts/assets/prism.mjs
osps_qa_01_02_justification: The full git history, with authors and dates, is public: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/commits/main
osps_qa_02_01_justification: The dependencies are listed in package.json, with every version locked in package-lock.json: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/package.json
osps_qa_04_01_justification: The project has a single repository.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: No generated executables are committed: the build output (dist) is ignored, and the site is built in CI.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: The only binary files are images (WebP, JPEG, PNG and the favicon), no executables or archives.
osps_vm_02_01_justification: Security contacts (email and GitHub private vulnerability reporting): https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
osps_ac_04_01_justification: Every workflow sets read-only permissions at the top level, and jobs ask only for what they need: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
osps_br_02_01_justification: The site is continuously delivered: each deployed version is identified by its git commit ID, which GitHub records for every GitHub Pages deployment: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/deployments
osps_br_04_01_justification: Every deployment is a merge of one pull request, whose description says what changed and how to test it; security fixes are described in GitHub security advisories: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
osps_br_05_01_justification: Dependencies are installed with npm ci from the lockfile, which checks their integrity hashes, in every pipeline; the deploy job installs them with no dependency cache: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
osps_br_06_01_justification: The site is not distributed as assets anyone downloads or installs: browsers load it from GitHub Pages over HTTPS, deployed only by the deploy job from main: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md#deploying
osps_do_06_01_justification: How dependencies are chosen, obtained, tracked and fixed: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
osps_gv_01_01_justification: Who has access to the repository, the site and its domain: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity
osps_gv_01_02_justification: The maintainer and contributor roles and their responsibilities: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles
osps_gv_03_02_justification: Requirements for code contributions: architecture, coding style, checks, sign-off, commits and pull requests: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contributing-code
osps_le_01_01_justification: Every commit must carry a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off, checked on every pull request by the DCO app and required by the ruleset on main: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin
osps_qa_03_01_justification: The ruleset on main requires the status checks (check, dependency-review and DCO) and CodeQL results to pass before merging; only an administrator can bypass it: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#code-scanning
osps_qa_06_01_justification: The check job runs the unit tests, builds the site and runs every check on it on every pull request; it must pass before merging: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
osps_sa_01_01_justification: The architecture (the posts, the page templates and components, the build scripts, the metadata and Content Security Policy steps, and the checks): https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#architecture
osps_sa_02_01_justification: The site's external interfaces are its pages and, for writers, the front matter of a post, described in the contributing guide; it has no API: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#writing-a-post
osps_sa_03_01_justification: The assurance case assesses the most likely and impactful security problems: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md
osps_vm_01_01_justification: Coordinated disclosure, with acknowledgement within 7 days and a fix within 30 days for serious issues: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
osps_vm_03_01_justification: Private reporting through GitHub private vulnerability reporting or the security email: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
osps_vm_04_01_justification: Vulnerabilities are published as GitHub security advisories once fixed and deployed: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
osps_ac_04_02_justification: Each job declares only the permissions it needs: the deploy job pages: write and id-token: write, the labeler and auto-assign pull-requests: write and issues: write, the Scorecard job security-events: write and id-token: write: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
osps_br_01_04_justification: The workflows take no manual inputs, and the only values from a pull request used in a script, its commit SHAs, are passed through environment variables: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
osps_br_02_02_justification: Each deployment is recorded by GitHub against its commit, and its Pages artifact is built from that commit in that run: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/deployments
osps_br_07_02_justification: The project has no secrets; deploying uses a short-lived OIDC token, and how a secret would be handled: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets
osps_do_03_01_justification: The site is not distributed as assets anyone downloads or installs: browsers load it from GitHub Pages over HTTPS, deployed only by the deploy job from main: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md#deploying
osps_do_03_02_justification: The site is not distributed as assets anyone downloads or installs: browsers load it from GitHub Pages over HTTPS, deployed only by the deploy job from main: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md#deploying
osps_do_04_01_justification: Only main and the live site built from it are supported; a fix is live once merged and deployed: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
osps_do_05_01_justification: Older commits, forks and copies hosted by others get no security updates: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
osps_gv_04_01_justification: Collaborators are reviewed, including two-factor authentication, before getting escalated permissions: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#becoming-a-maintainer
osps_qa_02_02_justification: The site is not distributed as assets anyone downloads or installs: browsers load it from GitHub Pages over HTTPS, deployed only by the deploy job from main: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/README.md#deploying
osps_qa_04_02_justification: The project has a single repository, so there are no subprojects in other repositories.
osps_qa_06_02_justification: When and how the checks run, locally and in CI: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#checks
osps_qa_06_03_justification: New functionality must come with a check that covers it, and a bug fix with a check that fails without it: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#checks
osps_qa_07_01_justification: The project has one maintainer, so no non-author approval is possible yet. A review by a maintainer other than the author is required once there is a second maintainer: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#becoming-a-maintainer
osps_sa_03_02_justification: Threat model, trust boundaries and attack surface: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md#threat-model
osps_vm_04_02_justification: Vulnerabilities in dependencies that don't affect the site are recorded as OpenVEX statements: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/vex.openvex.json
osps_vm_05_01_justification: Thresholds for fixing vulnerability findings in dependencies, and the licences a dependency may have: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
osps_vm_05_02_justification: What happens to dependency findings before a change is merged and before a deploy: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
osps_vm_05_03_justification: Dependency review checks every pull request against the GitHub Advisory Database and blocks a new dependency with a known vulnerability of any severity, except the accepted exceptions recorded in the policy: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/.github/dependency-review-config.yml
osps_vm_06_02_justification: The ruleset on main blocks merging while CodeQL reports an error or a high or critical security alert: https://github.com/phun-ky/phun-ky.github.io/blob/main/SECURITY.md#code-scanning
